propositions: Six process recommendations from bleakish-stational-cob audit require evaluation against prior decisions, janitor work, and implementation outcomes before proceeding to new work items.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as fail-open optional creation field in evadible-ambitious-canary; coverage is 1.1% and should be expanded at known automated-filer boundaries rather than mandated globally.

Deterministic plan preflight (P1-P11 floor) already exists and should extend only for recurrent mechanically-decidable failure classes demonstrated in persisted review data, with offline replay validation and fail-open behavior.

Completion-failure classification should first derive categories from 351 existing FAIL sidecars offline before adding schema; current 72.3% first-pass rate conflates code defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, scope gaps, and verifier failures.

Risk-tiered review should pilot reporting without merge enforcement, measuring signals (security, store, concurrency, diff breadth, complexity) against defect/revert outcomes rather than imposing human-review requirements on autonomous governance.

Proactive debt management must not adopt arbitrary LOC/duplication quotas; the 720-LOC warning already shipped; remediation should target concrete clone families and call-graph seams near capacity/complexity/churn intersections.
